_readme: Hand-kept inputs for scripts/fetch_cfb.mjs. dob: 'Name|School' (or just 'Name') -> YYYY-MM-DD, used for decimal age. players: 'Name|School' or 'Name' -> {note: '...'}, shown as an asterisk on the board. Grades always come from the model. injuries: [{name, team, status ('Out (season)', 'Out', 'Doubtful', 'Questionable', 'Probable', 'Active'), note, until (optional YYYY-MM-DD, dropped from that day)}], applied over the news feeds until removed.
